messages:
alice: FYI hitting a weird onboarding/friction bug in the Go sampleapp around generator streaming + auth refresh. repro attached below, short summary: stream hangs on shutdown if token refresh races with ctx cancel.

alice: Repro steps: start sampleapp (calls Generator.Stream), hit ctrl-C, app waits ~30s then exits with 'context canceled' but goroutines stay for a while.

alice: Minimal log: ```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z INFO starting generator stream
2026-03-20T14:02:20Z INFO token refresh started
2026-03-20T14:02:20Z INFO ctx cancelled, initiating shutdown
2026-03-20T14:02:50Z ERROR stream read loop: context canceled
```

devon: Ugh. Been meaning to look at our token refresh hook. Is the refresh happening in a background goroutine that might re-attach to the stream?

sam: Can you paste the sampleapp snippet? my guess: the auth middleware calls RefreshToken(ctx) but doesn't return immediately when ctx is cancelled, so handshake gets stuck.

alice: Snippet: ```go
ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Generator.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for tok := range stream.Recv() { fmt.Print(tok.Text) }
```
Note: client has automatic token refresh inside transport.

priyanka: I repro'd locally. The transport's refresh mutex holds while making a blocking network call, and the Stream.Recv path tries to reacquire it on auth failure -> deadlock-like behavior on shutdown.

sam: Short-term suggestion: ensure RefreshToken observes ctx and returns quickly on cancel. Long-term: maybe the streaming API needs an explicit handshake cancellation path so the generator runtime can be told to abort mid-handshake.

priyanka: Agreed. Proposal: add a StreamWithCtx method that takes a parent ctx used only for lifecycle (not auth retry), plus a separate authCtx that auth can cancel. Example: `Generator.Stream(ctx lifecycleCtx, opts ...StreamOpt) (StreamHandle, error)` where StreamHandle.Recv(ctx) uses an auth-aware subcontext.

devon: Another idea: expose a small opt `StreamOpts{AuthRetry: RetryPolicy{CancelOnParentCtxCancel: true}}` so we don't proliferate APIs.

alice: Either approach works for us; main ask is to make the common sampleapp path not leak goroutines or hang on ctrl-C. Also would be great to document recommended patterns in the onboarding guide (sample code + explanation of auth race).

sam: I'll open a PR with a quick fix: make refresh return on ctx.Done, add improved test coverage for shutdown. Will also prototype the StreamWithCtx API in a separate branch.

oncall-bot: CI: test/generator-stream-shutdown passed on PR #4281 :white_check_mark:

alice: Thanks — leaving this thread with the repro and proposed API notes. @sam @priyanka please ping when you have the PR link so I can update the sampleapp in docs.
